主な変更: [platform-server.mjs](/home/runner/work/akinael-ai/akinael-ai/src/platform-server.mjs)、[release-e2e.mjs](/home/runner/work/akinael-ai/akinael-ai/portal/scripts/release-e2e.mjs)、[core-quality.yml](/home/runner/work/akinael-ai/akinael-ai/.github/workflows/core-quality.yml)、[QA_REPORT.md](/home/runner/work/akinael-ai/akinael-ai/portal/QA_REPORT.md)
